description:
Kang Rak-Won, the CEO of a planning company who started out as an idol, hears the news of the suicide of Lee Do-Woon, who used to be in the same team. Ten years ago, Team Delight was disbanded due to Do-Woon's betrayal, so Rak-Won attends the funeral with mixed feelings. Rak-Won takes a short nap at the funeral. When he wakes up, he has returned to the past 20 years ago. However, the members are already slightly out of sync.

 *"Everything is so easy for you, hyung."
"Do it without me. I don't want to sing."
"I don't even have that much skill... It's ridiculous. The song I wrote."* 

Rak-Won fights to prevent the team's disbandment and Lee Do-Woon's suicide. The story of three dogs with different owners and servants regaining their idol status.

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

*Note: Includes ten extra chapters.*
